payload.reason: The evidence provides specific language pairs explored in the context of multilingual neural machine translation (MNMT) and zero-shot translation scenarios.

claims.text: The explored language pairs include Arabic, Spanish, and Russian, which can translate mutually among themselves, resulting in six zero-shot translation directions.
The Europarl corpus evaluates translation among French, English, and Spanish, as well as German and Romanian with English as the pivot language.
The distant language pair Romanian to German (Ro→De) is specifically mentioned as part of the evaluation process.
